services.desc: GROUP LESSON SCHOOL YEAR OPTIONS: TUES 6-7 PM, FRI 5:30-6:30 PM, SAT 10-11 AM/11 AM-12 PM Group lessons at the Fremont Table Tennis Academy Tri-Valley Branch offer a fun path to start one’s table-tennis journey. They are open to all levels with group lessons possible on Tuesdays, Fridays, and Saturdays. Group lessons are a great way to test a student’s interest in table-tennis. Students will learn the proper table-tennis skills interspersed with fun games. National and regional coaches will teach the group lessons with a coach on every table.
